regime_context: Detector shows Big Banks as the leading theme with solid durability (0.72) but crowded, in a broad rotation (69% of themes eligible). The absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control in this market (gate_helps true), so the primary edge is avoiding themes that fail the gate. Momentum ranks are not predictive and crowding remains a sizing caution. Our leans therefore focus on trend-gate risk control, not return forecasting.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream – currently the highest-ranked challenger (score 0.86) but unscorable and not yet a confirmed handoff. Kill the watch if Big Banks' score lead widens back above 0.4 and durability stays above 0.6.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Leading eligible theme; the absolute trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns in Canadian sectors, supporting staying power. Crowding warrants capping exposure, not fading, per guardrails. Low conviction because momentum rank has no forward return edge and the leader's r10 is slightly negative.
theses.dissent: Crowding and a slightly negative short-term return (r10 -0.0062) may signal a topping pattern, and a broad market risk-off could overwhelm trend protection.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks' durability falls below 0.5 or becomes ineligible for 3 consecutive days.

falsifier.text: If Gold Miners become eligible (durability exceeds its threshold) and hold that status for 5 consecutive days.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers

falsifier.text: If Oil & Gas Producers' durability drops below 0.5 or becomes ineligible for 3 consecutive days.
